title: US diesel prices hit a record high of $5.85 on average
summary: US diesel prices have reached a record high of $5.85 on average, driven by geopolitical tensions including Iran-related conflicts and supply chain disruptions affecting the energy market.
problem_solved: Provides timely coverage of record-high diesel prices and their economic impact on consumers and industries.
why_valuable: Alerts readers to critical energy cost trends that affect transportation, agriculture, and supply chain expenses across the economy.
